Maria (CS): Heads-up — Whisper Labs pilot is going quiet. Week 2 -> week 3 active usage dropped ~70% after the initial onboarding. No tickets yet, no alerts on our side.
Ben (AE): Saw the same in the dashboard this morning. CTO said they were going to evaluate another vendor last week. They also paused the S3 auto-ingest.
Sophia (CS Manager): Oof. Do we have a root-cause signal? Is this adoption, pricing, or a regression from our side?
Devon (Product): We rolled the prompt-template update on Tue (canary->pilot). Possible API contract wobble, but no errors surfaced in post-deploy smoke. OpsBot: Deployment 2026-03-15T18:42:03Z completed to pilot cluster.
Maria (CS): Quick numbers snapshot I pulled:
```
week1_active_users: 42
week2_active_users: 29
week3_active_users: 9
avg_tokens_per_call: 120 -> 95
```
Ben (AE): I've got a 10am PT call with their eng lead tomorrow. Plan: validate if template change affected ingestion, confirm which competitor they're testing, and whether procurement timeline is shifting.
Sophia (CS Manager): OK — action plan request: Maria prep a 5-min artifact showing before/after flows + 2 example failing conversations by EOD; Devon enumerate changed templates and a rollback candidate; Ben confirm competitor name and timeline on the call; I'll stand up a short war room if we need exec outreach. :white_check_mark:
Maria (CS): Will drop logs & short screen recordings into the shared folder and tag you all. Also pinging their PM for context.
Devon (Product): If the issue is template-related, I can cut a canary rollback and route a small % of traffic back to previous template today.
OpsBot: Alert: pilot cluster saw a latency spike at 3251234588; engineers notified.
Ben (AE): If the competitor is undercutting feature X, we'll need a quick win to lock them in — discount + dedicated onboarding session? I'll surface during the call.
Sophia (CS Manager): Good. Reconvene after Ben's call. If the competitor looks likely to win, we'll trigger the renewal salvage playbook and loop in Solutions + Sales Engineering. Thanks all.
